programs.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programs.sub_title: The Quest for the Holy Grail
programs.desc: As the Third Reich rises to power, Himmler and the SS become fixated on the Holy Grail, interpreting much of the myth surrounding it as fact -- and the quest for it as attainable.

programs.title: Oracles & Prophets
programs.sub_title: Prophecies of Freedom, Blood Rain, Didyma
programs.desc: A young woman is guided by omens, dreams, and a profound sense of purpose to save the lives of the enslaved, the sky rains blood, igniting a primal fear in the people of Kerala, and an ancient prophecy urges an iconic warrior king into battle.

programs.title: A Cold War of Spies
programs.desc: In the 1960s, both countries have a grip on nuclear weapons, but the imbalance between U.S. and Soviet missiles is staggering; a fledgling communist government in Cuba provides the perfect opportunity for Nikita Khrushchev to position missiles.

programs.title: Nintendo 64 Quest
programs.desc: Jay eyes a boxed copy of Indiana Jones, but can he afford it and will the owner part with it?

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.sub_title: In the Name of Medicine (Jesse Lazear, Alexander Bogdonov, Michael Servetus)
programs.desc: Although modern medicine is capable of incredible feats, the ability to treat the human body follows hundreds of years of experimentation -- at times with deadly results.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A teenager obsessed with escape artist Harry Houdini plans to break free but lands in an icy grave and his soul takes a journey into the unknown; a woman with COVID in a medically induced coma is visited by the spirits of her relatives.
